restless.line: And the riot squad, they're restless
stanza: They're selling postcards of the hanging
The beauty parlor is filled with sailors
They've got him in a trance
One hand is tied to the tight-rope walker
The other is in his pants
And the riot squad, they're restless
As Lady and I look out tonight

restless.songTitle: Things It Would Have Been Helpful to Know Before the Revolution
restless.line: From time to time we all get a bit restless
stanza: From time to time we all get a bit restless
With no one advertising to us constantly
But the tribe at the former airport
Some nights has meat and dancing
If you don't mind gathering and hunting
We're all still pretty good at eating on the run
Things it would have been helpful to know before the revolution
